北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京阴天体感 9℃，记得添衣保暖，注意防干燥哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy with a feels-like 9℃. Remember to dress warmly and stay hydrated!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天体感 11℃，湿度高。出门带伞，注意保暖哦。
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is cloudy with a feels-like 11℃ and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella and stay warm.

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天体感 11℃，湿度不低。出门带伞，注意保暖哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is cloudy with a feels-like 11℃ and moderate humidity. Bring an umbrella and keep warm.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州晴朗体感 29℃，暖暖的！注意防晒，补充水分哦。
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is sunny with a feels-like 29℃, nice and warm! Remember sun protection and hydration.

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳晴天体感 22℃，体感舒适。记得补水，享受阳光！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is sunny with a feels-like 22℃, very pleasant. Remember to hydrate and enjoy the sun!
深圳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州阴天体感 9℃，湿冷感强。多穿点，别着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou is cloudy with a feels-like 9℃, quite damp and chilly. Dress warmly to avoid catching a cold!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天体感 10℃，风力 3级。出门多穿衣，注意防风哦！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is cloudy with a feels-like 10℃ and a 3-level wind. Dress warmly and mind the wind!
南京.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都阴天体感 15℃，体感舒适。带件外套，以防降温。
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with a feels-like 15℃, quite comfortable. Bring a jacket in case it cools down.

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉大雾，湿度 99%。能见度低，出行务必注意安全！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is foggy with 99% humidity. Visibility is low, please be extra careful when traveling!

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安阴天，湿度 100%。体感 10℃，多穿衣物，注意防潮。
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is cloudy with 100% humidity. Feels like 10℃, dress warmly and mind the dampness.

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆有雾，体感 15℃。能见度低，外出注意安全。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is foggy with a feels-like 15℃. Visibility is low, please be safe when going out.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨有霾体感 1℃。天气寒冷，外出务必多穿，注意防护。
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is hazy with a feels-like 1℃. It's very cold, please bundle up and protect yourself outdoors.
哈尔滨.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云体感 2℃，有点凉。出门多穿，小心着凉哦。

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云体感 13℃，早晚温差大。及时添减衣物，预防感冒。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is partly cloudy with a feels-like 13℃. Mind the temperature difference and prevent colds.

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛有雾，体感 4℃。能见度低，出行安全第一，多穿暖！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is foggy with a feels-like 4℃. Low visibility, prioritize safety and dress warmly!

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连有霾体感 7℃。出门注意防护，保暖也很重要哦。
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is hazy with a feels-like 7℃. Remember to protect yourself and stay warm when going out.
